ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AKASH INFRA-PROJECTS LIMITED announced the appointment of two Non-Executive Independent Directors, Mrs. Urvi Sachin Bhatt and Mr. Lalji Kishorji Vaghela, effective January 17, 2027, subject to shareholder approval. This enhances corporate governance and brings valuable expertise in finance, corporate social responsibility, and civil engineering relevant to the company's operations. No material red flags are identified, as the appointments appear to be a routine compliance and governance strengthening measure.
